facts.claim: Writer emits leading SP,3Ddevice:1..4 plus SP then windowmode/onlyactive/soundoff/musicoff plus SP in that order; writes strlen bytes, no terminating NUL or newline. Missing-file path writes device1/all flags0.

Read asks for256 bytes, uses first exact case-sensitive strstr3Ddevice:, sscanf%d at+9, and independent substring checks. The observed segment does not check returned read count, append a terminator or validate sscanf result/range before radioId1004-device.

Default callback selects radio1003 and clears four fields. DDX1004/1005/1006/1007 binds+7c/+80/+84/+88; dialog labels map to window/background skip/sound/music; radio1000..1003 maps4..1. Actual renderer/OS/game effects unverified.

contract.writer: Exactly own deviceCode1..4 and four Boolean fields; canonical12..52 ASCII bytes, SP delimiters, no NUL/newline, owned output. Source native nonzero BOOL normalized as explicit Boolean API policy.
contract.reader: Actual attached nonshared bytes; copy only firstmin(length,256), stop at first NUL within read, otherwise explicit bounded EOF-as-terminator replacement policy. First case-sensitive substring and C-ASCII whitespace/sign/decimal prefix, independent substring flags; reject missing/failed/overflow/out-of-range device rather than native uninitialized/range-dependent behavior. Returns settings/offset/boundary metadata, no source text.
contract.retained_semantics: Flags match inside other text; duplicate device first wins; trailing bytes outside first256 are unread; no token splitting, case folding, renderer backend mapping, authentication or IO.
contract.default: Separate explicit missing-file/default state; parser errors do not silently reset or write files.
contract.unsafe_native_boundaries: No claim to emulate reads beyond returned bytes, stack termination, failed sscanf/uninitialized local, overflow or unsupported radio values. Actual native runtime and game application remain unverified.
